crosswalk.rule: A national row whose published scientific name is an accepted WoRMS species with no WoRMS distribution record in the northwest Pacific assesses the Korean population named by its Korean name; it is assigned to the candidate with that Korean name that WoRMS accepts for the East Asian population. The same crosswalk links the RDA row of that name.
crosswalk.evidence: The row (category NT, pages as recorded on 2026-09-26) names 참문어 Octopus vulgaris. WoRMS AphiaDistributionsByAphiaID 140605 (O. vulgaris) returns 38 records, all in the Atlantic, Mediterranean and western Indian Ocean, none in the northwest Pacific; WoRMS accepts Octopus sinensis d'Orbigny (534443) for the East Asian common octopus, and the national list's scope is Korean waters. MABIK's national species list also uses 참문어 = Octopus vulgaris.

national_red_list_not_assigned.reason: Only the subspecies 북방전복 Haliotis discus hannai (LC, list printed p.1376 = viewer p.1378; index printed p.1471 = viewer p.1473) is listed; a subspecies assessment is not moved to the species. 까막전복 not found in the index.
